text:
camille: Heads up — RC cut in ~3h (20:00 UTC). We still have a couple of small version bumps and one potential hotpatch. If you need to land something, please state risk level (low/med/high) and whether a rollback exists.

maria: I have a metrics-exporter semver bump (0.3.4 -> 0.3.5). Tests green locally and in CI. low risk. no schema changes.

ajay: thanks — can you paste the changelog line and the PR link? want to check if it touches the metrics pipeline.

maria: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/metrics-exporter/pulls/412
changelog: "fix: avoid duplicate meter registration on init"
should be safe.

jordan: reviewing now, pinged @leo for quick approval.

release-bot: Reminder: release branch protection enters soft-freeze at 19:45 UTC and hard-freeze at 20:00 UTC. Late-merge exceptions require label `release/late-exception` + oncall approval.

leo: I can approve maria's PR now if CI is green. I also have a separate hotpatch request: revert a noisy debug log causing CPU spikes in runtime pool (PR ready). Risk: medium (affects perf), rollback: trivial (cherry-pick revert).

camille: @leo can you summarize the hotpatch in one line for the changelog and include the cherry-pick SHA we should apply to the release branch? also include a short deploy checklist.

leo: changelog: "perf: remove noisy debug log in runtime pool"
cherry-pick: `abc1234`
deploy checklist:
```
- cherry-pick to release branch
- run smoke on staging (smoke tags: runtime-smoke)
- canary on Dedicated for 15m
- monitor CPU/latency dashboards
- be ready to rollback (revert commit def5678)
```

sophie: Can we canary on Dedicated only to reduce blast radius? I can watch dashboards. low-blast suggestion.

ajay: Agreed — canary on Dedicated, hold Hosted API. If metrics look good after 15m we promote.

camille: Ok — @release-bot please mark leo's PR with `release/late-exception` and route to oncall for approval. @leo open the exception request doc in the PR checklist.

release-bot: Label applied: `release/late-exception`. Oncall: @sophie. Please respond with APPROVE or DENY within 30m.

sophie: APPROVE — canary plan sounds good. I'll watch dashboards and give thumbs within 20m. :thumbsup:

jordan: maria's PR merged in release branch at `def8901`. leo — once you push the cherry-pick I'll kick the staging smoke run.

maria: thanks everyone. merging to release now. low risk confirmed. :tada:

leo: cherry-picked `abc1234` to `release/v1.8` and pushed `hotpatch/log-noise-revert`. Kicked off staging smoke.

release-bot: CI for branch `release/v1.8` passed. Staging smoke OK. Canary started on Dedicated.

camille: Great — keep updates brief here. If anything unexpected, call the release channel and tag me.

sophie: Canary looks stable at +18m, CPU back to baseline. APPROVE promote.

camille: Promoting to hosted-offer later this hour after final checks. Thanks team!
